_note: DELIVERY PIPELINE SWITCH — the ONE value that decides which pipeline produces delivered pixels. Change it with `python scripts/pipeline.py --use <id>` (or --on/--off); never by hand-editing the derived flags in config/engines.json, config/pipeline_versions.json or policy/registry.json. The switch rewrites those from the profile below so the whole repo moves together and policy/check.py stays clean in either state. `python scripts/pipeline.py --status` shows what is live.

higgsfield.aka: engine 1 / legacy — the original production pipeline

format.note: Native 2K square straight out of the engine.

gflow-nb2.aka: engine 2 / gflow-nb2 — Nano Banana 2 reached directly through Google Flow

format.note: Flow renders 768x1376 portrait natively and upscales to 1536x2752; the delivered square is a 1536x1536 centre crop of that upscale. This is the largest square engine 2 can produce — 43.75% less pixel area than the 2048x2048 engine 1 delivers. Accepted by explicit, repeated user instruction 2026-08-22 ('Use google nano banana 2 pipeline do not use higgsfield now').

gflow-nb2.install: claude mcp add --transport http openflow https://openflowmcp.com/mcp
